items.en: Trump says Iran war 'effectively over' following talks with Qatar's Prime Minister.

items.en: Trump steps back from fresh Iran strikes following a 'regional appeal'.

items.en: Hamas says Board of Peace distorts Gaza flood crisis and overlooks Israel's role.
